cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your lettering's finally ready for more than bin labels. Eighty wedding place cards could show what my lessons gave you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like the lettering. I don't want to copy eighty names or argue with your aunt about purple ink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll read the names and handle my aunt. You could finally use that purple flourish I spent weeks teaching you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Without you correcting every capital letter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll keep my pen capped. You can make the guests wish I'd taken lessons from you.
